title: Linear recurrences for non-log-concave independence polynomials of trees
summary: We identify a structural pattern in the construction of known infinite families of trees whose independence polynomials are not log-concave. Using this pattern and properties of polynomial ring ideals, we derive linear recurrences for these polynomials. As a consequence, we prove that the set of non-isolated limit points of their zeros lies on the circle $|z+1/3|=1/3$ in the complex plane.
